intent: Stadium-commentary energy: the number, then the whole field in one bar chart, then the two records.
pacing_profile: question read verbatim, three options, 3-s beat, reveal with the number, story beats shaped per episode (brief.md), punchline + short follow

title: How many men's Cricket World Cups has Australia won?

lines.direction: the question, cold — curiosity comes from the map moving under it
lines.text: how many men's Cricket World Cups has Australia won?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: 6. Australia has lifted the men's World Cup 6 times, far more than any other nation.

lines.direction: the whole field as one bar chart, Australia's bar towering; rows stagger in as the countries are named
lines.text: India and the West Indies have won 2 each. Pakistan, Sri Lanka and England have 1 title each.

lines.direction: camera tightens on Australia while the unbeaten-run counter races to 34 and the country pulses on 'defeat'
lines.text: And between 1999 and 2011 they went 34 World Cup matches in a row without a single defeat.

lines.direction: fly north-west to India: the country fills on 'India' (via 'ahmedabad' cue lead-in), pin drops, the crowd counter spins to 92,453
lines.text: The latest came in 2023, beating hosts India in Ahmedabad, in front of 92,000 people.

lines.direction: punchline, then a short follow — the outro visual asks
